assumptions.execution_eligible: assumed True for research (stored prices carry no verified provider delay)
assumptions.shortable: assumed True for research; long-only results reported separately
assumptions.note: Assumptions make paper fills possible; they are not verified execution or borrow data.

method.unit: R = net P&L per share / initial risk (fill to frozen stop)
method.control: 20 random-timing twins per trade inside the same segment, full holding window observable: same direction, stop/target in ATR, costs and borrow; borrow accrues only until the actual exit
method.intervals: edge 95% CI bootstrapped by symbol (verdict); by-trade CI and minimum detectable edge reported alongside
method.periods: per timeframe, the last 30% of the covered span is held out; nothing is fitted on either period
method.fills: next bar open with half-spread + slippage; stop before target; gaps fill at the worse open
method.tuning: none; all variants reported; research_stop_target_only is NOT a live default
